company.name: HCLTech
company.tag: Builds, runs and repairs computer systems for big companies abroad, and sells its own software
products: Building and updating business software for clients (Digital Business Services)
Running clients’ data centres, cloud servers, networks and office computers (Digital Foundation Services)
Cybersecurity: guarding clients’ systems against attacks
Running back-office work such as customer calls, billing and accounts (Business Process Operations)
Online and classroom courses (HCLTech Career Shaper)
Designing chips, devices, vehicle software and factory systems for product makers
AI services and its AI Force platform
Software products sold on licence and subscription
company.productNote: The company reports three segments: IT and Business Services, Engineering and R&D Services, and HCLSoftware. The list follows the service lines named in its 2025–26 annual report.
